elements.content: A large group of NASA employees pose together indoors, with one person seated in front and the remainder standing behind him. No printed caption or photo credit is visible.

elements.title: Best Place to Work awards, 2012–2023
elements.content:
A two-row grid of award-certificate images. Printed year labels, arranged left to right:

Top row: 2023 | 2022 | 2021 | 2020 | 2019 | 2018
Bottom row: 2017 | 2016 | 2015 | 2014 | 2013 | 2012

Each year is paired with an image of a “Best Places to Work” award certificate. The adjacent printed statement says: “NASA has been named the ‘Best Place to Work in the Federal Government’ among large agencies for 12 consecutive years, with #1 ranking since 2012.”

elements.title: Certificates of Excellence in Accountability Reporting awards
elements.content: Photograph showing a row of AGA Certificates of Excellence in Accountability Reporting award trophies, with one larger trophy centered among the others. The trophies reference NASA and the National Aeronautics and Space Administration. No separate printed caption or photo credit is visible.

elements.title: Unmodified audit opinion documents
elements.content: Illustration or photograph of several stacked financial-report documents, with a magnifying glass highlighting a seal reading “Unmodified Opinion.” No separate printed caption or photo credit is visible.

NASA’s high quality financial reporting and results are a direct reflection of its award-winning work environment. 
NASA’s workforce is a diverse community that values teamwork and is united by a shared mission. The accomplishments 
featured in this year’s AFR demonstrate NASA’s legacy of excellence and innovation.
APPENDIX
AWARDS
Celebrating NASA 10+ Years of Excellence
NASA received its 10th Certificate of
Excellence in Accountability Reporting 
(CEAR) Award for its FY 2023 AFR from 
AGA. The CEAR award is the highest form 
of recognition in the Federal government 
financial community.
For the 13th consecutive year, NASA received an unmodified, or “clean,” opinion from the Independent 
Auditors on its FY 2023 financial statements. NASA’s financial statements and budgetary reporting have 
received the highest possible audit opinion, certifying that it adheres to Generally Accepted Accounting 
Principles for Federal agencies.
